overlap.comparison: The general compact physical martingale equivalence explains why a row-mean coupling implies convex order. It does not supply this coupling, its signed marginals, or the numerical efficiency.
It characterizes parameter-preserving martingale couplings under localized affine and convex tests. It neither verifies the R4 profile order nor calculates its exact best efficiency.
Its actual-fiber theorem gives automatic normal preservation if a physical martingale coupling exists. The existence for this centered R4 profile and the ratio 40/93 are additional.

readability: The factor 3W is the integer profile and W is the integrand weight; the proof consistently distinguishes them. No same-batch theorem is needed for the stated ratio.

summary: The verified finite martingale sends the positive part of the centered profile to the negative part with fixed edge normal and all physical means preserved. It proves the upper bound for the full stated cone; a constant potential attains exactly 40/93.
